description: Convx 1.5.3 (Beta) delivers targeted visual refinements, spring animation enhancements, and refined layout geometry across lyrics sharing and search navigation.

changelog.title: Search & Liquid Glass Interface
items: Restored full spring physics, inertia damping, and smooth slide animations for the category pill selector on the Search screen.
Maintained real-time liquid glass refraction and chromatic aberration depth across all display scales.

changelog.title: Lyrics Sharing Visual Polish
items: Removed background quotation mark watermark for a clean, minimalist typography presentation.
Eliminated outer card borders for a modern borderless aesthetic.
Perfected 24dp rounded corner curvature and removed dark corner artifacts in both the customization preview dialog and exported images.

changelog.title: Lyrics & Player Ergonomics
items: Optimized menu button hierarchy: the secondary track action menu is now reserved exclusively for landscape view, eliminating duplicate controls in vertical portrait mode.
Fixed layout padding assertions during lyric card rendering on high-density displays.

changelog.title: Performance & Architecture
items: Preserved high-speed direct CDN asset distribution for rapid in-app beta updates.
Ongoing performance improvements for low-latency audio playback and backdrop rendering.
